messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex V, Part B, point 5

5. A sentence declaring which essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( 3 ) are applied and fulfilled and that the relevant technical documentation was drawn-up in accordance with Annex IV, Part B, and, where appropriate, a sentence declaring the conformity of the partly completed machinery with other relevant Union harmonisation legislation.

response.text:
declaration of incorporation | mustState | which essential health and safety requirements of Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 are applied and fulfilled | "" | "A sentence declaring which essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 ... are applied and fulfilled"
declaration of incorporation | mustState | relevant technical documentation was drawn up in accordance with Annex IV, Part B | "" | "that the relevant technical documentation was drawn-up in accordance with Annex IV, Part B"
declaration of incorporation | mustState | conformity of the partly completed machinery with other relevant Union harmonisation legislation | where appropriate | "where appropriate, a sentence declaring the conformity of the partly completed machinery with other relevant Union harmonisation legislation"
